title: MCI Officer Roles
description: Duties and responsibilities of the MCI sector officers: Incident Commander, Triage, Treatment, Staging and Transport.

pearls.text: Confirm the MCI and make a rapid assessment of the incident.
Send the METHANE report and activate the MCI response plan.
Establish the command post and request support units.
Don the IC vest and assign the sector officers.
Coordinate with the other stakeholders and all EMS operations.
Obtain a briefing from the Incident Commander.
Obtain the Triage Officer portfolio, don the Triage vest and review the items in the portfolio.
Confirm with the Incident Commander that it is SAFE to begin, then begin triage operations — check all areas around the scene for potential patients (walkways, ejected patients, etc.).
Advise the Treatment Officer of the approximate number of patients as soon as possible.
Coordinate the transfer of patients by priority to the appropriate treatment area. Advise the Incident Commander when initial triage and tagging are complete.
Obtain a briefing from the Incident Commander. Obtain the Treatment Officer portfolio, don the Treatment vest and review the items in the portfolio.
Determine the equipment and personnel needed in the treatment area, and coordinate the personnel assigned to it.
Establish the primary treatment area. The Treatment Officer should NOT become involved in physical tasks.
Re-triage patients on arrival at the treatment area, place them in the appropriate section, and complete the Casualty Log Sheet as patients pass through.
Advise the Transport Officer when patients are ready for transport and which hospital each should go to. Evacuate patients BY PRIORITY.
Obtain a briefing from the Incident Commander and the Staging Officer portfolio.
With the EMS and DCD Fire Commander, establish the location of the staging area:
points: Consider safety, HAZMAT, wind direction, etc.
Divide it into three distinct, well-marked areas: Medics / Paramedics / Advanced Paramedics
Consider the need for a secondary staging area

pearls.text: Proceed to the staging area, don the Staging Officer vest so you can be recognised, and review the items in the portfolio.

Get the location of the ambulance loading zone from the Transport Officer and send the proper number and types of units to it. Report to the Incident Commander for reassignment when your tasks are complete.
Obtain a briefing from the Incident Commander. Obtain the Transportation Officer portfolio, don the vest and review the items in the portfolio.
Coordinate with Main Dispatch on hospital capabilities and bed capacity. Begin the Casualty Log Sheet — it must tally with the Treatment Officer's own log.
Consult the Treatment Officer and establish the ambulance loading zone.
Advise / coordinate with the Staging Officer on the best location for the loading zone and the access routes.
Consult the DCD Fire Commander to establish a landing site for the Police Air Wing, and notify the Incident Commander of the locations.
